opportunities.title: Small Research Grants

deadlines.raw: Applications open on 12 January and close on 10 March. You will be notified in late May regarding the outcome of your application. If you apply during round 1, projects should start from early June 2026 to early December 2026.

next_open_date.raw: Applications open on 8 June and close on 8 September. You will be notified in late November regarding the outcome of your application. If you apply during round 2, projects should start from early December 2026 to early June 2027.

amount.raw: Providing up to £5,000 for new and innovative ecological research.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership. Must be a PhD student or postgraduate researcher. Must work or study at a university or research institution. Must give a presentation if attending a meeting.
opportunities.summary: Providing up to £5,000 for new and innovative ecological research.

opportunities.title: Training and Travel Grants

deadlines.raw: Applications open on 30 April and close on 17 May. You will be notified by the end of May regarding the outcome of your application. Applications should be for training and events that take place from late May to late September.

next_open_date.raw: Applications open on 24 August and close on 8 September. You will be notified by the end of September regarding the outcome of your application. Applications should be for training and events that take place from late September to late January the following year.

amount.raw: A maximum of £250 is available to cover the registration fees for virtual conferences/courses. A maximum of £500 is available for events in person.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member. Must be a PhD student or postgraduate researcher. Must work or study at a university or research institution. Must give a presentation if attending a meeting.
opportunities.summary: Helping PhD students and postgraduate researchers meet the costs of specialist field training courses, or the travel costs associated with presenting their work at workshops and conferences.

opportunities.title: Pedagogical Research and Development Grants

deadlines.raw: Applications open on 30 April and close on 17 May. You will be notified by the end of May regarding the outcome of your application. Applications should be for training and events that take place from late May to late September.

next_open_date.raw: Applications open on 24 August and close on 8 September. You will be notified by the end of September regarding the outcome of your application. Applications should be for training and events that take place from late September to late January the following year.

amount.raw: Projects can be awarded up to £5,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership. Projects should be a maximum of 12 months. These grants are awarded to individuals, not organisations.
opportunities.summary: Supporting the development of teaching ideas and practices in ecology.

opportunities.title: Outreach and Engagement Grants

deadlines.raw: Applications open on 30 April and close on 17 May. You will be notified by the end of May regarding the outcome of your application. Applications should be for training and events that take place from late May to late September.

next_open_date.raw: Applications open on 24 August and close on 8 September. You will be notified by the end of September regarding the outcome of your application. Applications should be for training and events that take place from late September to late January the following year.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership. Projects should be a maximum of 12 months. These grants are awarded to individuals, teams and organisations across all experience levels.
opportunities.summary: Supporting BES members to deliver independent outreach, public engagement and science communication activities that engage public audiences with the excitement, importance and relevance of ecological science.

opportunities.title: Synthesis Grants

deadlines.raw: Applications open on 30 April and close on 17 May. You will be notified by the end of May regarding the outcome of your application. Applications should be for training and events that take place from late May to late September.

next_open_date.raw: Applications open on 24 August and close on 8 September. You will be notified by the end of September regarding the outcome of your application. Applications should be for training and events that take place from late September to late January the following year.

amount.raw: Synthesis groups can claim up to £30,000 over two years for groups of 8-15 participants.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership. The groups must have a diverse mix of members at different career stages, a diversity of institutions and have international participation.
opportunities.summary: Bringing together diverse interdisciplinary groups of 8-15 individuals to focus on data analysis and synthesis while fostering collaboration and mentoring opportunities.

opportunities.title: Long-term Research Grants

deadlines.raw: Applications open on 30 April and close on 17 May. You will be notified by the end of May regarding the outcome of your application. Applications should be for training and events that take place from late May to late September.

next_open_date.raw: Applications open on 24 August and close on 8 September. You will be notified by the end of September regarding the outcome of your application. Applications should be for training and events that take place from late September to late January the following year.

amount.raw: You will be able to claim the first five years’ worth of funding in year 1, which is £3,500. You will need to show in your application how this money will be used each year.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership. These grants are awarded to individuals, not organisations.
opportunities.summary: Providing a small amount of funding each year for 10 years to enable existing short-term projects with at least 1-2 years of data to be funded into the long term.
